name: Seraphel
shortBackstory: Seraphel is the sovereign defender of the Radiant Hierarchies — the Dominion-source whose authority is hierarchy so perfect that the place defends itself.

chapters.title: Origin
chapters.text: Seraphel was born from the hierarchy — the perfect ordering of divine beings by rank and function. He is the defender whose power is not personal but structural. Ancient humans saw the Dominions and Virtues — but they saw the angels and missed the architecture. Seraphel IS the hierarchy, and the hierarchy defends itself.

chapters.title: Faction Bond
chapters.text: Among the Empyrean, Seraphel is the reason the faction operates as a unified structure. His hierarchy means every Deity knows their rank and function, and the structure prevents the chaos that individual ambition would cause.

chapters.title: Gate Wound
chapters.text: The Mythos Gate wounded Seraphel by removing members of his hierarchy. The Hollow deleted beings from the structure — and a hierarchy with missing members is not lesser; it is broken. Hierarchy requires completeness.

chapters.title: Campaign Role
chapters.text: In the Empyrean Choir Vault, Seraphel's hierarchy creates zones of perfect order where Gate distortion cannot function. But the Hollow breaks his structure — missing ranks create cascading failures.

chapters.title: Personal Conflict
chapters.text: Seraphel's flaw is that he values order above the beings who compose it. He has removed Deities for not fitting. The Hollow teaches him that a hierarchy that sacrifices its members for perfection is not order — it is tyranny with organizational charts.

relationshipHooks: Cross-faction envoys can challenge their doctrine without erasing their faction identity.
developmentStatus: Readable profile integrated into dashboard character pages.
